blocks.content: Course: React Query: The Practical Guide
You've finished TaskFlow. But this doesn't have to be the end.
Here are some ideas to keep building on your own:

items: Add authentication and fetch only the logged in user's tasks
Add a search bar with the enabled flag so it only fetches after 3 characters
Add optimistic create so new tasks appear instantly without waiting for the server

blocks.content: Each one of these will push you to use React Query in a slightly new way.
And you now have everything you need to figure them out.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
